why: Minnesota’s past results for school boards are not loaded yet.
g: Judges, county offices, soil and water supervisors, cities, townships, school boards, hospital districts and local questions

Minnesota publishes these results statewide only in the Secretary of State's 'Media Files', on results websites that turn automated requests away with a CAPTCHA, so this site does not ask them. They will be added when a copy of that election's Media Files is saved by hand. The Geospatial Commons table loaded here carries only the federal, statewide and legislative contests.
